1: // Asteroid Escape game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
5: canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
6: 
7: // Starfield background
8: const STAR_COUNT = 100;
9: const stars = [];
10: for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
11:   stars.push({
12:     x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
13:     y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
14:     r: Math.random()*1.5+0.5
15:   });
16: }
17: 
18: function drawStars(){
19:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
20:   stars.forEach(s=>{
21:     ctx.beginPath();
22:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 2*Math.PI);
23:     ctx.fill();
24:   });
25: }
26: 
27: // Audio assets
28: const bgMusic = new Audio('bg-music.mp3');
29: bgMusic.loop = true;
30: bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
31: const collisionSound = new Audio('collision.wav');
32: let bgStarted = false;
33: 
34: // Ship definition
35: const ship = {x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-30, w:20, h:30, speed:4};
36: let keys = {};
37: addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
38: addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
39: 
40: function drawShip(){
41:   ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
42:   ctx.strokeStyle='blue';
43:   ctx.lineWidth=2;
44:   ctx.beginPath();
45:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
46:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x-ship.w/2, ship.y+ship.h);
47:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x+ship.w/2, ship.y+ship.h);
48:   ctx.closePath();
49:   ctx.fill();
50:   ctx.stroke();
51: }
52: 
53: // Asteroids
54: let asteroids=[];
55: let lastSpawn=0;
56: let spawnInterval=1000; // ms
57: let startTime=Date.now();
58: let gameOver=false;
59: 
60: function spawnAsteroid(){
61:   const size = 10+Math.random()*20;
62:   const x = Math.random()*canvas.width;
63:   const y = -size;
64:   const speed = 1+Math.random()*2 + (Date.now()-startTime)/60000; // increase over time
65:   asteroids.push({x,y,r:size,speedY:speed});
66: }
67: 
68: function update(dt){
69:   // ship movement
70:   if(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a) ship.x-=ship.speed;
71:   if(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d) ship.x+=ship.speed;
72:   ship.x = Math.max(ship.w/2, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w/2, ship.x));
73:   // asteroids
74:   asteroids.forEach(a=>a.y+=a.speedY);
75:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a=>a.y - a.r < canvas.height);
76:   // spawn
77:   if(Date.now()-lastSpawn>spawnInterval){spawnAsteroid();lastSpawn=Date.now();}
78:   // collision
79:   for(let a of asteroids){
80:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
81:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
82:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
83:     if(dist < a.r + ship.w/2){
84:       gameOver=true;
85:       collisionSound.play();
86:       break;
87:     }
88:   }
89: }
90: 
91: function draw(){
92:   // background
93:   ctx.fillStyle='black';
94:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
95:   drawStars();
96:   // ship
97:   drawShip();
98:   // asteroids with gradient
99:   asteroids.forEach(a=>{
100:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
101:     grad.addColorStop(0, 'lightgray');
102:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'dimgray');
103:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
104:     ctx.beginPath();
105:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, 2*Math.PI);
106:     ctx.fill();
107:   });
108:   // score
109:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
110:   ctx.shadowColor='black';
111:   ctx.shadowOffsetX=1; ctx.shadowOffsetY=1; ctx.shadowBlur=2;
112:   ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
113:   const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now()-startTime)/1000);
114:   ctx.fillText('Time: '+seconds+'s',10,20);
115:   ctx.shadowColor='transparent';
116: }
117: 
118: let lastTime=0;
119: function loop(timestamp){
120:   // start background music on first frame after user interaction
121:   if(!bgStarted && (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.ArrowRight || keys.a || keys.d)){
122:     bgMusic.play();
123:     bgStarted = true;
124:   }
125:   if(gameOver){
126:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
127:     ctx.font='40px sans-serif';
128:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2-100, canvas.height/2);
129:     return;
130:   }
131:   const dt = timestamp-lastTime;
132:   lastTime=timestamp;
133:   update(dt);
134:   draw();
135:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
136: }
